opening.argument: The presentation walks viewers through purchasing a BitClub mining share, recommends the smallest pool, and sets out a $99 membership payment plus $500 for the smallest package. The speaker says the share will become active after ten days and produce daily profits, then directs viewers to complete the payment in Bitcoin by sending it to a digital address within a ten-minute window. The accompanying invoice displays the Bitcoin amount, destination address, QR code, and expiration countdown. Although a separate page shows “Payment Received,” the records do not establish that the transaction resulted from the offer or that any promised profits were delivered.
